claims: Lester Martínez is a Guatemalan boxer.
Lester Martínez became the new interim super middleweight world champion of the Consejo Mundial de Boxeo (CMB) on March 21, 2026.
Lester Martínez defeated Immanuwel Aleem by unanimous decision.
The fight took place in San Bernardino, California.
Lester Martínez maintained his undefeated record.
The victory elevates Lester Martínez's record to 20 wins and 0 losses.
Immanuwel Aleem is an American fighter.
The fight took place at the National Orange Show Event Center in San Bernardino, California.
Lester Martínez is positioned as second in the CMB super middleweight ranking, only behind Saúl "Canelo" Álvarez.
Lester Martínez is the first boxing world champion in the history of Guatemala.
